Carries a boxed warning in United States

summary: Levomethadyl Acetate was pulled from the market in the European Union starting in 2001 because of heart harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a low score of 36 for liver issues and a medium score of 54 for heart issues [M]. Related drugs also show serious risks, as Methadone carries the strongest type of United States warning label for misuse, breathing trouble, and heart harm, while Propoxyphene has this warning and was removed from markets in the United States and five other countries for heart harm [4][5].
